fields.name: apiKey
fields.label: Personal API key
fields.placeholder: Paste the key Garmin Connect showed you
fields.hint: The dashboard reads Garmin Connect with a Personal API key of your own. On connect.garmin.com, signed in: Settings, Personal API key (connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken), Create Key, accept the terms and pick how long it lasts (30 days to a year). Garmin shows the key once: copy it here and save. It stays in this scene's settings on the frame, like a password. Garmin emails you a week before it runs out.

fields.name: server
fields.label: Garmin Connect account
fields.hint: Where your Garmin Connect account lives. The key works only on its own.

garmin.name: Garmin
garmin.description: Your day from Garmin Connect: Body Battery over the last day, steps against your goal, last night's sleep and its score, HRV status, stress, the week's steps and intensity minutes, resting heart rate and your last activities. Reads Garmin's Personal API with a key you make on Garmin Connect.
